notes: T521/D-a (token capture, mechanical) — the CAPTURE PATH, per amend directive D043 (read and acked via bin/managent inbox T521 --ack; recorded here per the T352 inbox loop). G1 IS RUN-TIME, NOT RETROACTIVE: tokens are captured at dispatch or lost. D043 corrected the row's first attempt (a retroactive pi-session reader only — its findings file and regression were superseded by this rewrite, model attribute deepseek-v4-pro; that work was never committed). THE INSTRUMENT (tools/token-capture.py, deliverable): parse_claude_envelope() extracts BOTH the result text and the usage counts from `claude -p --output-format json` stdout (envelope shape ground-truthed against claude 2.1.237 in a live probe on 2026-08-20: single-line JSON {type:'result', result:<text>, usage:{input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, output_tokens_details:{thinking_tokens}}}); write_tees() saves the COMPLETE raw stdout+stderr per task under untracked/tokens/ so any usage lines survive (D043 item 2 — the deepseek/pi and ollama/qwen capture); append_ledger() writes one record per run to untracked/tokens/tokens.jsonl — a READING (tokens_in/out + source) or an explicit MISSING (nulls + missing_reason), never estimated, never a blank cell (D043 item 3; the 6/6 blank tokens.template.md with n=0 is the recorded breach being replaced). THE WIRING: tools/runner (the process every lane passes through) pipes child stdout, parses the claude envelope at exit, forwards the UNWRAPPED text to the lane's stdout (out.md / verification / grading see the answer, never the envelope), prints the bakeoff G1 trailer line `[runner] tokens_in=N tokens_out=M`, stamps the run record (tokens_in/out/source/missing_reason always present — self-describing), and writes the ledger + tees. bin/subagent:260 flipped --output-format text -> json (the exact defect D043 named); tools/bakeoff.sh lane_argv/lane_emit_cmd claude lanes flipped the same way so race lanes get the envelope too; both command-shape regressions updated (tools/regression-subagent-prompt.sh 3b, tools/regression-dispatch.sh 13a). The pi session JSONL scan (the retroactive meter for pi lanes, from the superseded attempt) is kept as the G1 fallback: token-capture.py --json --cwd <root> --since <date> builds the models map the bakeoff joins on — the dispatch-time ledger reading WINS for a label; labels with no ledger reading fall back to the session scan; every missing record appears in the `missing` section. TEST-FIRST (standing tooling rule): tools/regression-token-capture.sh written and shown RED before the implementation (both the flag regressions were also flipped to the NEW expected shape first and run red), then green; arms: A envelope parse (text+usage, tokens_in==input+cache_read, tokens_out==output, is_error -> missing not 0/0, garbage passthrough), B claude lane e2e through the runner (run record, trailer line, unwrapped stdout, ledger reading, raw-envelope tee), C pi lane e2e (raw stdout+stderr teed per task, ledger missing with reason, run record null+reason), D G1 join (ledger wins for claude, session scan fills pi, missing section), E ledger hygiene (every record exactly one of reading-with-source or missing-with-reason), G/H/I reader-mode controls. Wired into `zig build test` via build.zig (token_capture_regression step, added after the T542 bakeoff-gates block).
